result.instructions: Tools for IPQualityScore, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is this IP address a proxy, VPN or Tor exit node? Give me its fraud score."; "Is this email address disposable, and does its domain accept mail?"; "Is this phone number valid, and is it a VoIP or prepaid line?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes IPQualityScore data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ipqualityscore_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ipqualityscore_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ipqualityscore_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ipqualityscore_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_ip
tools.title: Check an IP address
tools.description: Score an IP address for fraud risk: proxy, VPN, Tor, bot, recent abuse, and the fraud_score (0-100). Use it on sign-ups, logins and payments. Each call uses IPQualityScore credits. API: GET /api/json/ip/{key}/{ip}.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to check.

strictness.description: How deep the check goes. Higher is slower and can flag more false positives.

allow_public_access_points.description: True skips some checks for schools, research institutions and some companies.

user_agent.description: The visitor's browser user agent, for better accuracy.

user_language.description: The visitor's browser language, for better accuracy.

user_id.description: Your own user id, stored as tracking data (userID).

transaction_id.description: Your own transaction id, stored as tracking data (transactionID).

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_email
tools.title: Check an email address
tools.description: Validate an email address: deliverability (valid, disposable, catch-all, suggested fix for typos), MX/SPF/DMARC, leaked or honeypot status, and fraud_score. Use it before sending mail or creating an account. API: GET /api/json/email/{key}/{email}.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the full check, 1-60. The vendor default is 7. Longer is more accurate.

fast.description: True returns a faster, less detailed check.

abuse_strictness.description: Abuse pattern strictness, 0-2. Higher can flag more legitimate addresses.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_phone
tools.title: Check a phone number
tools.description: Validate a phone number: validity, line type (mobile, VoIP, prepaid, toll-free), carrier, country, active status, risky and recent-abuse flags, and fraud_score. Give the number with its country code. API: GET /api/json/phone/{key}/{phone}.

phone.description: The phone number, with its country code (for example 18007132618).

country.description: Expected country codes (for example ["US", "CA"]) to check the number against.

strictness.description: Verification strictness. Higher increases the checks and can raise the fraud_score.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_url
tools.title: Scan a URL
tools.description: Scan a URL for malware, phishing and spam: unsafe flag, domain age, category, redirects, final URL, adult content and risk_score. Use it before showing a user a link. API: GET /api/json/url/{key}/{url}.

url.description: The full URL to scan, with its scheme (for example https://example.com).

strictness.description: Scan strictness, 0-2. 0 is the least strict and fits most uses.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_get_credits
tools.title: Get credit balance and usage
tools.description: Read the account's remaining credits and this billing period's usage per product (ip, email, phone, url, mobile SDK). Call it to see how many lookups are left. API: GET /api/json/account/{key}.
